description: A silver sedan sits on a circular pale platform in a dimly lit industrial hall, lit by two overhead spotlights with light beams. The car has glowing orange outline cutaways over its front engine bay and a rear door area showing a grey battery pack. The background is dark windows, steel beams and a balcony rail. The painting is in a loose oil-paint style and fills the frame edge to edge. A small emblem sits on the nose. No people are visible.
